payload.name: modify_restaurant_reservation
payload.description:
Move an existing confirmed restaurant reservation to a new date/time (and
optionally a new party size), keeping the same confirmation code. Restaurants
verify with last name + confirmation code (no card, no email). Read the new
details back to the caller before calling this, and relay the party size from
this tool's return when confirming - it's how a wrong count gets caught.

new_date.description: the new date, in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-20").
new_date.title: New Date

new_time.description: the new time, in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. "18:00").
new_time.title: New Time

new_party_size.description: new number of guests, ONLY when the caller states the new number. "Keep it the same" means OMIT this parameter - the reservation keeps its current size when omitted. Never fill it with a number the caller didn't say.
new_party_size.title: New Party Size
